source_commitment.does_not_establish: The digest does not disclose or independently validate the private baseline.

claims.statement: The later public publication record identifies 10.5281/zenodo.22019208 as the version DOI for Release v1.0.0 and 10.5281/zenodo.22019207 as the concept DOI.
does_not_establish: Certification, correctness, or independent technical review.
Byte identity between Zenodo's generated source archive and the attested GitHub release bundle.

claims.statement: Seven audit reports were preserved across three governed reviews.
does_not_establish: That every attempted round was auditable; one attempted round was explicitly recorded as not auditable.
That the review set contains every defect that existed.

claims.statement: The retained reports contain 33 findings: 11 HIGH and 22 MEDIUM, with no CRITICAL finding recorded.
does_not_establish: The absence of undiscovered defects.
That every finding had the same operational impact.

claims.statement: Resolution records mark 32 findings as fixed and one as settled through an owner-ratified criteria revision.
does_not_establish: That the revised criterion was originally met.
That every final-round correction received another audit round.

claims.statement: Three final-round findings were recorded as defects introduced by earlier corrective work.
does_not_establish: That all later corrections were defect-free.
That every remediation defect was discovered.

claims.statement: Each of the six substantive audit reports recorded a changes-required verdict.
does_not_establish: That remediation was never completed.
That every attempted audit round produced a substantive verdict.

claims.statement: The implemented assurance has explicit isolation, liveness, evidence, and review limitations.
does_not_establish: Formal verification, full isolation, defect-free operation, or external certification.

claims.statement: The system design binds review to exact source checkpoints and durable transition records.
does_not_establish: Correctness of every implementation change.
External institutional independence of the audit role.

claims.statement: The final governed review was limited to two owner-authorized audit rounds.
does_not_establish: A third audit of final-round corrections within the same review.

claims.statement: Existing project environments were recorded as migrated and locally connected without project-specific drift.
does_not_establish: Future runtime state.
Application visibility.

claims.statement: The owner separately confirmed the final application-visible state.
does_not_establish: Cryptographic remote attestation.
Future application visibility.

claims.statement: Approval and release are modeled as separate controlled actions.
does_not_establish: That approval alone merges, tags, publishes, or deploys source.

claims.statement: The committed completion record reports a versioned correctness release.
does_not_establish: Independent reproduction of the private release.
That the public technical record has itself been released.

claims.statement: The later public publication record records the signed release commit, signed annotated tag, immutable GitHub Release, SHA-256 release checksums, and GitHub artifact-attestation workflow for v1.0.0.
does_not_establish: Software correctness, defect-free operation, or independent technical review.
That the later default-branch publication record is part of the v1.0.0 Release or its signed Git objects.

claims.statement: The later public record states that independent technical review has not been performed and that no external certification is claimed.
does_not_establish: That the prepared review package constitutes a completed review.
Any predicted conclusion of a future independent reviewer.

claims.statement: The system design separates owner authority, implementation, read-only audit, durable evidence, and release.
does_not_establish: External certification or legal independence.
That no privileged operator could bypass every host control.

claims.statement: The committed completion record reports the capability categories summarized in the public implementation record.
does_not_establish: A public reconstruction of the private implementation.
Future operation outside the recorded release boundary.

claims.statement: The committed completion record reports 1,111 tests green in both the hermetic and explicit live-host tiers.
does_not_establish: An independently replayed final run.
A retained raw final test log or JUnit artifact.
Complete correctness of the system.
